title: Chamber
description: data/<iso3>/{lower,upper,unicameral}.yaml: the composition of one chamber, by parliamentary group.

name_local.description: Name of the chamber in the country's language.

seats.description: Total number of seats in the chamber, vacant ones included.

vacant.description: Seats currently vacant. The groups' seats plus this must equal `seats`.

source.description: Id of the entry in data/sources.yaml the seat counts come from.

updated.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the seat counts in this file were last changed.

id.description: Identifier of the group, unique within the chamber. It survives renames: never change it once published, and give a new group a new id.

name.description: Official name of the group, in the chamber's language.

color.description: Hex colour used to draw the group's seats.

parties.description: Ids of the parties (from the country's country.yaml) the group is made of. Empty for groups that are not tied to any party, such as non-attached members.

parties_source.description: Where the link between the group and its `parties` can be checked: preferably a record of the members' parties (the parliament's open data, the declarations of party attachment), else the group's or its parties' own page, else a secondary source such as Wikipedia. Required when `parties` lists any party.
